experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly trend reversal after sustained 10-hour uptrend
experiment.hypothesis: A sustained 10-hour uptrend in BTC-USD hourly close prices is associated with a statistically significant reversal in the following hour, independent of broader market regimes.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Test whether the reversal occurs with the same frequency and magnitude in a holdout period of BTC-USD data that excludes the 10-hour uptrend period.
